purpose: Browser-first visual roles. Skeletal humans and monsters use a shared bone-bound facial identity atlas; models remain optimized stylized assets rather than photoreal character scans.

sky_system.notes: Generated by VisualDirector: sky color, sun disc, cloud planes, fog and zone lighting.

grass_material.notes: Generated in-game as batched multimesh grass blades with zone-tuned color.

road_cobble_material.notes: Generated in-game as layered rough stone road material for Greyfen.

mud_road_material.notes: Generated in-game as wet dark road material for Wychwood.

player_human.notes: Connected 32-bone Warrior body with native Face mesh, clothing, hair, embedded animation clips, and one-pass normalization. Kael's authored sword and back scabbard remain bone-attached by PlayerController.

sister_anwen_human.notes: Connected 32-bone Cleric body with native Head mesh, robe, staff, and embedded animation clips. The native staff is used without a duplicate overlay.

mira_human.notes: Distinct compact Monk silhouette used for Mira's practical herbalist identity tint and animation family.

rook_human.notes: Distinct Rogue silhouette with native Face mesh, belt, pouch, dagger, and embedded locomotion/combat clips for Rook and traveler roles.

villager_human.notes: Connected native-face crowd base with deterministic worker palette.

villager_female_human.notes: Connected native-face female crowd base with deterministic mourner palette; native staff is suppressed for non-cleric crowd roles.

villager_worker_human.notes: Connected native-face worker base with forge palette and real work-compatible idle animation.

villager_hooded_human.notes: Connected native-face traveler base with hood-compatible dark palette and Rogue movement family.

castle_guard_human.notes: Connected native-face guard base with Vargan palette, imported armor silhouette, and real sword-compatible rig.

road_ranger_human.source: Quaternius Modular Character Outfits: Fantasy, optimized runtime export
road_ranger_human.notes: Complete 65-bone skinned Ranger outfit with native hood/body pieces, shared non-root-motion UAL2 clips, and 1K runtime maps. Used by Captain Senn and road ranger roles.

ghoul_gaunt_real.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh
ghoul_gaunt_real.notes: Connected gaunt cursed-human body for Ghoulkin and Raider profiles.

orc_skull_real.notes: Rejected for released Ghoulkin presentation after identical-camera review: oversized cartoon proportions and weak horror identity. Retained only as a quarantined source reference.

ghoul_stalker_real.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh

ghoul_brute_real.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh
ghoul_brute_real.notes: Broad Wychwood heavy body with connected face, hands, and feet.

ghoulkin_skeleton.notes: Legacy articulated source retained for audit and fallback comparison only. Wychwood no longer maps to this generic skeleton; released roles use the connected Ghoul family GLBs.

bell_eater_boss.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh
bell_eater_boss.notes: Bell-Eater uses the connected GhoulBrute source at focal-creature scale; harness, chest bell, jaw, teeth, horns, and phase light are one encounter identity layer.

rootbound_colossus_boss.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh
rootbound_colossus_boss.notes: Rootbound uses one normalized connected body at colossus scale with a bark mantle, root feet, crown branches, and a phase-reactive exposed oathwood heart.

white_hart_avatar.notes: Connected animated animal base; spectral antlers are attached to the imported head bone at runtime.

white_hart_boss.notes: Finale display and encounter use one 3.60 m normalized wolf-derived Hart role with bone-attached spectral antlers, pale moonlit material, oath mark, and phase identity.

ashwing_creature.notes: Interim dragon silhouette for Ashwing. It replaces the incorrect OrcSkull mapping while a skinned flying-drake source is prepared; flight presentation remains controller-driven until that source is available.

ashwing_boss.notes: Ashwing uses the connected animated Dragon source at focal-creature scale with charred harness, ember core, and scorched wing-root identity dressing.

bog_wretch_creature.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh
bog_wretch_creature.notes: Connected long-limbed cursed-human body with swamp material profile; keeps the Bog Wretch from falling back to a primitive Slime mesh.

gravebound_knight_creature.source: Ashen Oath derived CC0 production mesh
gravebound_knight_creature.notes: Connected broad cursed-human body with iron/ash material profile; replaces the incomplete Skeleton OBJ until the authored Vargan armor outfit is ready.
